报告元数据.主营业务: 风电机组的研发、制造与销售，以及风电场的设 计、建设与运营管理
报告元数据.企业名称: 三一重能股份有限公司
报告元数据.报告名称: 三一重能2025年度环境、社会及治理（ESG）报告

环境管理体系.值: 公司已建立环境管理体系，由董事会作为最高责任机构，在执行层面设立安全生产、职业健康、消防安全与环境保护委员会（安全委员会），由总经理担任主任，负责环境管理的战略决策与监督；HSE管理部作为执行部门，统筹环境管理体系建设、环境绩效提升和日常监测管理。报告期内，公司修订了《环境政策》，新增废水、废气、固废及二氧化碳排放控制目标，并完善了《突发环境事件应急预案》的组织架构和应急流程。
环境管理体系.原文: The Board of Directors is the highest responsible body for the Company's environmental management. A Safety Production, Occupational Health, Fire Safety, and Environmental Protection Committee... is established at the executive level, chaired by the Company's general manager... The HSE Management Department, as the executing department, coordinates the construction of the environmental management system... By revising the Environmental Policy, new control targets for wastewater, waste gas, solid waste, and carbon dioxide emissions were added...

碳管理体系建设.值: 公司已连续第五年开展全价值链温室气体盘查，识别运营及上下游价值链的温室气体排放源，并基于盘查结果建立科学减排目标和清晰的脱碳路径。公司于2024年7月正式向科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）提交《企业雄心助力1.5°C温控目标承诺书》，承诺以公开透明方式推进气候行动，力争2050年实现价值链净零排放，并计划在24个月内完成基于SBTi标准的中短期、长期及净零排放目标设定并提交SBTi验证。
碳管理体系建设.原文: The Company has conducted a full value chain greenhouse gas inventory for the fifth consecutive year... In July 2024, the Company officially submitted the "Commitment Letter for Corporate Ambition to Support the 1.5°C Temperature Goal" to the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), committing to advance climate action in an open and transparent manner, aiming to achieve net-zero emissions across its value chain by 2050. The Company will set near-term, long-term, and net-zero emissions targets based on SBTi standards and plans to complete the target setting and submit it for SBTi verification within 24 months.

能源类型和强度.原文: Comprehensive Energy Consumption (MWh) 355,590.00; Total Direct Energy Consumption (MWh) 46,212.53; Total Indirect Energy Consumption (MWh) 309,377.47; renewable energy accounted for 13.17% of the energy used by SANY Renewable Energy, and purchased green electricity across the Company's sites totaled 33,575.94 MWh.

节能目标与改造情况.值: 公司制定《能源管理工作制度》，成立能源管理领导小组，建立覆盖全公司的能源管理网络。2025年，公司重点构建光伏发电、储能系统与绿电交易相结合的综合路径以优化能源结构。报告期内，三一重能、三一智能电机、三一通榆、三一张家口、三一韶山、三一郴州、三一塔城、三一巴彦淖尔已获得ISO 50001能源管理体系认证。
节能目标与改造情况.原文: we have formulated the Energy Management Work System based on national energy work policies and energy management standards... An energy management leadership group has been established... By the end of 2025, SANY Renewable Energy, Sany Intelligent Motor, Sany Tongyu, Sany Zhangjiakou, Sany Shaoshan, Sany Chenzhou, Sany Tacheng, and Sany Bayannur have obtained ISO 50001 Energy Management System certification.

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: 公司要求供应商在准入时完成《三一重能供应商企业社会责任自评问卷》，明确10条红线标准。在供应商评估与管理中，优先考虑战略供应商和可持续发展高风险供应商。报告期内，公司优化了供应商评估流程，对高风险供应商依据《可持续发展尽职调查表》进行尽职调查，并将调查结果纳入供应商绩效评估考量。全年共236家供应商接受绩效评估。
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: requiring suppliers to complete the SANY Renewable Energy Supplier Corporate Social Responsibility Self-Assessment Questionnaire at onboarding, clarifying 10 red-line criteria... For high-risk suppliers, the Company conducted due diligence based on the Sustainability Due Diligence Review Form, and incorporated the investigation results into supplier performance evaluation considerations. A total of 236 suppliers underwent performance evaluation throughout the year.

供应商绿色采购标准.值: 公司作为风电行业首家获得ISO 20400可持续采购符合性声明的企业，持续推进2030可持续采购目标与行动计划。公司更新了《供应商管理政策》，进一步明确供应商开发与寻源、准入评估、绩效评估、退出/淘汰各阶段的管理要求。
供应商绿色采购标准.原文: As the first enterprise in the wind power industry to obtain an ISO 20400 Sustainable Procurement Statement of Conformity, the Company has been proceeding continuously with its 2030 sustainable procurement goals and action plan... we updated the Supplier Management Policy, further clarifying management requirements for each stage: supplier development and sourcing, supplier admission assessment, supplier performance evaluation, and supplier exit/removal.

包装减量及回收情况.值: 公司积极践行绿色包装与循环利用原则，基于减量化、再利用、再循环和再设计理念，系统优化包装材料管理。通过与第三方机构合作建立木箱回收机制，每年回收再利用约30,000个木箱用于运输自产产品，相当于节约1,537.84吨木材。公司推广使用木托盘替代塑料托盘，并实施金属托盘替代木托盘的小规模试点，每月可减少150个木托盘的浪费。同时，公司减少塑料包装膜使用，选择可生物降解和可回收塑料包装膜用于产品包装。
包装减量及回收情况.原文: SANY Renewable Energy has established a wooden box recycling mechanism in collaboration with third-party organizations, recycling and reusing approximately 30,000 wooden boxes annually for shipping its self-manufactured products, which equates to saving 1,537.84 tonnes of wood. The Company promotes the use of wooden pallets to replace plastic ones and has implemented a small-scale initiative to use metal pallets instead of wooden ones, which can reduce the waste of 150 wooden pallets each month. While reducing the use of plastic packaging films, the Company opts for biodegradable and recyclable plastic packaging films for product packaging.

循环经济链塑造.值: 公司开展退役叶片处置方案研究，持续监测可回收树脂技术发展，作为叶片回收再利用的技术规划与准备。同时倡导对下塔筒发电机主要部件进行修复和再利用，减少资源浪费，促进风电行业循环经济。
循环经济链塑造.原文: the Company conducted research on decommissioned blade disposal solutions and continuously monitored the development of recyclable resin technologies, as part of technical planning and preparation for blade recycling and reuse. We also advocated the practice of repairing and reusing main components of down-to-tower generators to reduce resource waste and foster the circular economy within the wind power industry.

供应链碳风险传导影响评估.值: 公司高度重视供应链风险管控，报告期内完善了供应链风险与机遇的识别、评估和管理机制。依据《供应商风险评估办法》，定期审查和识别供应商风险等级，并制定针对性风险控制措施或实施细则。在供应商评估与管理中，优先考虑战略供应商和可持续发展高风险供应商，以有效避免或降低供应链风险。截至报告期末，公司未识别出存在“重大风险”的供应商。报告期内，公司识别出18项供应链相关风险和4项供应链相关机遇，并针对每项风险和机遇，根据其重要性程度制定了切实可行的管理策略和应对措施。
供应链碳风险传导影响评估.原文: The Company places high importance on supply chain risk control, enhancing mechanisms and processes for identification, assessment, and management of supply chain risks and opportunities during the Reporting Period... By the end of the Reporting Period, the Company did not identify any suppliers with "significant risks"... During the Reporting Period, the Company identified 18 supply chain-related risks and 4 supply chain-related opportunities, and for each risk and opportunity, we developed practical management strategies and response measures based on their importance levels.
